verdict.rationale: Simular's own platform can run tasks on a Simular-hosted Windows or Linux cloud computer instead of your own device, which gives an isolated execution environment. Approval gates before sensitive or irreversible actions add some protection. However, nothing documents a sandbox or test mode, test credentials, or any guarantee that production data stays untouched, and persistent logins suggest these machines are used with real accounts. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test environment, separation from production data or accounts, test API keys or a dry-run mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
